specs.title: switching theme persists across reload and keeps controls usable
customer drawer creates and edits data with validation and delete confirmation
catalog product drawer saves code, price, active state and changes without touching other products
quotation full flow supports per-customer prices, edits, PDF download and approval
generic quotation omits the customer block and template copies keep independent versions
core pages have no serious accessibility violations
login starts with empty credentials and returns to the requested route
VAT is appended to export only when selected and saved amounts are preserved
mobile products show every field and usable actions without horizontal columns
support request reaches Kanban and can be processed, completed and reopened
downloaded HTML opens with product image while offline
